name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
tagline: Plitvice — boardwalk lakes and waterfalls; one entrance loop, not every trail.

practical.ticket_note: Timed tickets often required; buy ahead in peak season.
practical.transit_note: Two main entrances; buses from Zagreb/Zadar.
practical.energy_note: Lots of walking and stairs; strollers hard on boardwalks.
practical.best_start: Ticketed entry → boardwalk lake circuit → exit shuttle if offered
practical.season_note: Peak summer crowded; shoulder seasons nicer.
